MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: normal volatility at 32.1% and broad participation, with 8/8 sectors positive on the week. The advance is broad, but many sectors remain below their 1M levels.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads (+21.49% 1W, +5.09% 1M), led by THYAO (1W: +23.55% | 1M: +4.54%) ABOVE TREND and PGSUS (1W: +23.13% | 1M: +3.74%) ABOVE TREND. Technology & Telecom ranks second; KONTR (1W: +46.45% | 1M: +29.47%) is ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Retail & Food (+5.62% 1W, -7.48% 1M) is the weakest sector, with SOKM (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -11.93%) BELOW TREND. Heavy Industry (+6.65% 1W, -11.74% 1M) and Construction & REIT (+6.05% 1W, -10.11% 1M) also show weekly gains against negative monthly returns.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +46.45% | 1M: +29.47%) is ABOVE TREND; THYAO (1W: +23.55% | 1M: +4.54%) and PGSUS (1W: +23.13% | 1M: +3.74%) are ABOVE TREND. TRMET (1W: +18.98% | 1M: -11.54%) is RECOVERY; TAVHL (1W: +17.80% | 1M: +6.99%) is ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
SOKM (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -11.93%), ASELS (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -4.87%), TUPRS (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -11.13%), TKFEN (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -29.48%) and TCELL (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -9.46%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly moves came from KONTR (1W: +46.45% | 1M: +29.47%) ABOVE TREND, THYAO (1W: +23.55% | 1M: +4.54%) ABOVE TREND and PGSUS (1W: +23.13% | 1M: +3.74%) ABOVE TREND. TRMET (1W: +18.98% | 1M: -11.54%) is RECOVERY, while TAVHL (1W: +17.80% | 1M: +6.99%) is ABOVE TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking gained 12.17% on the week and 1.43% over the month; GARAN (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +11.09%), ISCTR (1W: +14.08% | 1M: +2.47%) and YKBNK (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +1.75%) are ABOVE TREND. AKBNK (1W: +12.73% | 1M: -0.87%) is RECOVERY, so the sector advance is stronger than some individual monthly trends.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry rose 6.65% on the week but remains down 11.74% over the month. FROTO (1W: +11.76% | 1M: -0.95%), TOASO (1W: +15.06% | 1M: -7.43%) and EREGL (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -14.95%) are RECOVERY; ASELS (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -4.87%) remains BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector gained 9.54% on the week but is down 13.46% over the month, with the sector quant screen disqualified on its 2W return. TRMET (1W: +18.98% | 1M: -11.54%) and GUBRF (1W: +15.58% | 1M: -26.28%) are RECOVERY, while TUPRS (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -11.13%) is BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a selective pro-risk stance: favor relative-strength leaders in transportation and banking, while keeping exposure disciplined given 32.1% volatility and mixed 1W-versus-1M signals across sectors. Avoid treating weekly rebounds as confirmed trend reversals where 1M returns remain negative.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track KONTR (1W: +46.45% | 1M: +29.47%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +23.55% | 1M: +4.54%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. GARAN (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +11.09%) is ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +18.98% | 1M: -11.54%) is RECOVERY and needs confirmation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation and Banking for continuation, as both have positive 1W and 1M sector returns. Watch Energy & Chemicals for whether its sharp weekly rebound can improve the still-negative monthly trend.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels were provided, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated. Monitor whether volatility moves above 40% and whether breadth contracts from 8/8; either would weaken the current risk-on signal.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Normal volatility and 8/8 positive sector breadth support a RISK-ON stance, with transportation, technology and banking leading. Momentum is concentrated in a few names, while negative monthly returns across several sectors leave rebound durability as the key risk.
